fact: A study of Bongor and Gounou-Gaya (period November 2024) reports a 26% national birth registration rate (MICS6 2019), under 5% of deaths registered nationally, one digitised centre in Bongor's provincial hospital maternity and a 100% paper system in Gounou-Gaya.
title: Ndoletar Luc, Gestionnaire de projet, CEA Mentors CRVS
publisher: CEA Mentors CRVS (Get in the Picture)
